sources.title: Gedanken-Experiments on Sequential Machines
sources.enterprise_use: Provides classical prior art for finite deterministic sequential machines, state outputs, and distinguishing internal states by finite experiments/observable behavior. P018 Supplement 18 uses this lineage only to classify future-observation distinguishability and finite state refinement as established automata territory before studying its finite-precision interpretation.
sources.not_claimed: Finite-state observational distinguishability, Moore-machine style behavioral reduction, and sequential-machine minimization are established mathematics/computer science and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Linear automaton transformations
sources.enterprise_use: Provides classical automata/congruence prior art neighboring the use of future-indistinguishability equivalences and minimal quotient representations. P018 does not claim Nerode-style congruence/minimization as new; it studies the exact finite precision-state closure criterion and its interaction with P005/P009/P010/P011/P018.
sources.not_claimed: Nerode equivalence, right-congruence/minimal-automaton ideas, and quotient minimization in automata theory are established and are not Enterprise Math inventions.
